notes.title: Bug fixes! Patch notes for Supreme 9.5
notes.content:
[b]New![/b]
[list]
[*]Allow loading [b].ogg[/b] files as custom sounds.
[*]Add page numbers and multi-filtering (right-click on category) to Monster, Sound, and Item lists.
[/list]
Fixed:
[list]
[*]Add a fallback if Steam Workshop upload [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2547330/discussions/0/565867809387614568/]fails due to file permission issues[/url].
[*]Fix SWC-only items appearing by mistake in some imported Dr. L worlds.
[*]Fix rare bugs with Suckers, Blowers, and Sphinx Arms with different AIs set.
[/list]
Also:
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/SpaceManiac/HamSandwich/tree/steam-17789150]HamSandwich has been updated[/url] as well.
[/list]

[*]Fix rare bugs with Suckers, Blowers, and Sphinx Arms with different AIs set.

notes.title: Weapon un-lock! Patch notes for Supreme 9.4
notes.content:
[b]New![/b]
[list]
[*]Add third control "Wpn Lock" that toggles the Wpn Lock setting while held. For example, if Wpn Lock is on, this acts as a "pick up" button. It's also usable in Specials. The default is [b]Tab[/b].
[/list]
Fixed:
[list]
[*]Fix graphical pop-in on very large items and monsters.
[*]Fix sounds far to one side sometimes wrapping around and coming from the other side instead.
[*]The [b]F11[/b] hotkey now cycles through possible sizes, instead of just tiny and huge.
[*]The Special Trigger selector now keeps the NOT/AND state instead of clearing it.
[/list]
Also:
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/SpaceManiac/HamSandwich/tree/steam-15331543]HamSandwich has been updated[/url] as well.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fixes! Patch notes for Supreme 9.3
notes.content:
[b]New![/b]
[list]
[*]Add bullet selection menu to relevant specials, [url=https://github.com/SpaceManiac/HamSandwich/pull/17]contributed by Hyperme[/url].
[*]Increase per-world tile limit from 800 to 1000.
[*]Add editor help message explaining how to enable Custom JSP for items.
[/list]
Fixed:
[list]
[*]Fix visual bugs when combining underwater/lava, handheld mode, and movies.
[*]Fix Steam Workshop uploads occasionally re-including files from previous uploads.
[*]Fix Creeping Cone having an attack sound when it shouldn't.
[*]Fix water splash particles sometimes flashing the wrong color (especially obvious when raining on Splatter Mode).
[*]Fix a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2547330/discussions/0/4040354734347124363/]missing text file[/url] in Halloween Horror 2 - TG.
[*]Fix Summon Bullet prompt to indicate that equations are allowed.
[*]Fix Summon Bullet's facing information for Cheese Hammer (was 8, should be 255).
[/list]
Also:
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/SpaceManiac/HamSandwich/tree/steam-13653279]HamSandwich has been updated[/url] as well.
[/list]

notes.title: Achievement icons! Patch notes for Supreme 9.2
notes.content:
[b]New![/b]
[list]
[*]Add [url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/2547330/achievements/]one hundred unique achievement icons[/url] by the skilled [url=https://twitter.com/benrose_hsb]Ben Rose[/url]! Enjoy them in your Steam library or on your profile and brag about your accomplishments to your friends.
[*]Add new "Advanced" HUD option with a level timer and weapon lock status, [url=https://github.com/SpaceManiac/HamSandwich/pull/15]contributed by AutomaticFrenzy[/url].
[*]Verify add-on world [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3027942977]"Lost Levels" by SpaceManiac[/url] for leaderboards and add it to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3017821391]the workshop collection[/url].
[/list]
Fixed:
[list]
[*]Make volume multiplicative instead of subtractive, so lower volumes doesn't cause quiet sounds to be fully muted.
[*]Fix issue where repeated sounds like AK-8087 fire could be [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2547330/discussions/0/3884975615298288712/]cut off too soon[/url] and effectively silenced.
[*]Fix rare possibility of Traffic [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2547330/discussions/0/3884975615298288712/]phasing through an obstacle at the very start of the level[/url].
[*]Fix playable Dr. Lunatic sometimes firing one too few lightning zaps on hit.
[*]Fix Bestiary in SpisMall being [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2547330/discussions/0/3884975231686597346/]inescapable on gamepad[/url]. The Back button now quits it.
[/list]
Also:
[list]
[*]A call for levels for a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2547330/discussions/0/3884974960175122660/]Halloween Horror merge world[/url] is active.
[*]SpisMall arcade game leaderboards are [url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/2547330/leaderboards/11836744]public on Steam Community[/url], along with many more worlds.
[*][url=https://github.com/SpaceManiac/HamSandwich/tree/steam-12467972]HamSandwich has been updated[/url] as well.
[/list]

notes.title: Time leaderboards! Patch notes for Supreme 9.1
notes.content:
[b]New![/b]
[list]
[*]Add new Top Time online leaderboards to complement Top Score
[*]Add Record below Total Score on the level tally for comparison, like the other factors
[/list]
Fixed:
[list]
[*]Fix Classic HUD option applying incorrectly to the SpisMall
[*]Fix sounds sometimes being cut off even though there are still free channels
[*]Fix Steam Overlay preventing Manic Mode from working on Windows
[*]Fix a Linux case-sensitivity bug
[/list]
Also:
[list]
[*]Several [url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/2547330/leaderboards/11595271]world leaderboards have been made public on Steam Community[/url].
[*][url=https://github.com/SpaceManiac/HamSandwich/tree/steam-12266330]HamSandwich has been updated[/url] as well.
[/list]
